newsitem.title: USA: ESCO sees improved operating margins.
newsitem.headline: ESCO sees improved operating margins.

text.p: ESCO Electronics Corp Chairman Dennis Moore on Tuesday said he expected the company's operating margins to improve in fiscal 1997.
"We expect growth in our commercial business and operating margin improvements throughout the company," Moore said in a statement.

For the first quarter ended December 31, the diversified manufacturer of commercial and defense products reported earnings of $0.18 a share, compared with $0.17 in the year-earlier period. Revenues declined to $68.9 million from $112.6 million. Results for the most recent period exclude the company's Hazeltine subsidiary, which was sold in July 1996.

Moore said the company's recent acquisition of Filtertek Inc, a manufacturer of plastic insert injection-molded filter assemblies, "substantially strengthens the company's position in the filtration/fluid flow market and greatly improves our prospects for future commercial growth."

ESCO said new orders in the first quarter were $57.1 million, compared with $108.5 million in the same year-ago period. Excluding Hazeltine, new orders for the fiscal 1996 first quarter were $71.5 million.
